description: This file implements an Android activity and related components demonstrating how to use loaders with throttling in a content provider. It includes a custom content provider, database helper, activity setup, list fragment with loader callbacks, and functionality for populating and clearing data in the database with throttling.

classes.name: LoaderThrottle
classes.description: Main activity class demonstrating loader and content provider usage with throttling.

classes.name: MainTable
classes.description: Defines the database table schema and content URI for the data used in the loader demo.

classes.name: DatabaseHelper
classes.description: SQLiteOpenHelper subclass managing database creation and upgrades.

classes.name: SimpleProvider
classes.description: A minimal content provider implementation exposing the database data.

classes.name: ThrottledLoaderListFragment
classes.description: Fragment displaying a list of data loaded via a CursorLoader with throttling, with options to populate and clear data.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and adds the list fragment.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates options menu with Populate and Clear actions.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles Populate and Clear menu actions to modify database content.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Initializes list adapter, sets options menu, and starts loader.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles list item clicks (currently logs the click).

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates a CursorLoader with a throttle of 2000 ms to limit update frequency.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Swaps the cursor in the adapter once loading is complete.

methods.name: onLoaderReset
methods.description: Clears the cursor from the adapter when loader is reset.
